featuredSection.title: Three videos to help you build a steady foundation

lessons.title: Fish
lessons.summary: Tap play to begin today’s Bible School lesson.

lessons.title: Job
lessons.summary: Read Scripture through the video and strengthen your foundation of faith.

lessons.title: Noah's Ark
lessons.summary: Invite family and friends to learn together and let truth shape everyday life.

lessons.title: God Makes the World
lessons.summary: In the very beginning, the world was empty, dark, and quiet. But God was there, full of power and purpose, getting ready to make something wonderful.

lessons.title: Let There Be Light
lessons.summary: Then God spoke, and light shined into the darkness. He separated the light from the dark, making day and night, and the very first day began.

lessons.title: God Makes the Sky and Land
lessons.summary: God made the wide sky above and gathered the waters below so dry land could appear. The earth was beginning to take shape, just as God planned.

lessons.title: Plants and Trees Grow
lessons.summary: God told the earth to grow grass, plants, and fruit trees, and right away the land became green and full of life. Everything grew beautifully because God said so.

lessons.title: The Sun, Moon, and Stars
lessons.summary: God placed the sun in the sky for the day and the moon and stars for the night. Their lights filled the heavens and helped mark times and seasons.

lessons.title: Fish and Birds Fill the World
lessons.summary: God filled the waters with swimming creatures and the sky with flying birds. The world was now full of movement, songs, and life in every direction.

lessons.title: Animals and People
lessons.summary: God made all the animals that walk on the earth, big and small. Then He did something special—He decided to make people in His own image.

lessons.title: Made in God's Image
lessons.summary: God created man and woman in His image and blessed them. He gave them the care of His beautiful world, and when He looked at everything He had made, He said it was very good.

lessons.title: God Rests
lessons.summary: After six days of creating, God finished His work. On the seventh day, He rested, making it a holy day and showing that His work was complete.

lessons.title: A World Waiting to Bloom
lessons.summary: Before the plants had fully grown and before rain had fallen, the earth was waiting quietly. God was preparing the world for the story that was about to unfold.

lessons.title: Adam and the Garden
lessons.summary: God formed Adam from the dust of the ground and breathed life into him. Then He placed Adam in a beautiful garden filled with lovely trees and everything he needed.

lessons.title: The River of Eden
lessons.summary: A river flowed through Eden, watering the garden and bringing life wherever it went. The land around it was rich and beautiful, a place prepared by God's loving hands.

lessons.title: The Lands Around Eden
lessons.summary: The rivers from Eden stretched far into the lands beyond, showing how large and wonderful God's creation was. Everything around the garden spoke of His goodness and care.

lessons.title: One Important Command
lessons.summary: God gave Adam work to do in the garden and told him he could eat from every tree except one. It was a loving command, teaching Adam to trust and obey God.

lessons.title: No Helper Like Him
lessons.summary: Adam named all the animals, one by one, but none of them was just right to be his helper. God knew Adam needed someone special by his side.

lessons.title: God Makes Eve
lessons.summary: While Adam slept, God made a woman from his side. It was a beautiful gift from God, because Eve was made to be Adam's perfect companion.

lessons.title: Together in Joy
lessons.summary: When Adam saw Eve, he was filled with joy. The man and woman lived together in peace before God, with nothing to hide and nothing to fear.

lessons.title: The Serpent's Lie
lessons.summary: One day, the serpent spoke to Eve and twisted God's words. He tried to plant doubt in her heart and make disobedience seem harmless.

lessons.title: The Forbidden Fruit
lessons.summary: Eve looked at the fruit and wanted it, and then she ate it. Adam ate it too, and in that sad moment, they chose not to obey God.

lessons.title: Hiding from God
lessons.summary: As soon as Adam and Eve sinned, they felt shame and tried to hide. When God called to them, they were afraid and began blaming others for what they had done.

lessons.title: Life Becomes Hard
lessons.summary: Because of sin, the ground would no longer be easy to work, and life would become full of pain, sweat, and struggle. Even so, life would continue, and Eve would become the mother of all living.

lessons.title: God Cares Even After Sin
lessons.summary: Even after Adam and Eve disobeyed, God still cared for them and made clothes for them. But because sin had entered the world, life could no longer stay the same.

lessons.title: Sent Out of the Garden
lessons.summary: Adam and Eve had to leave the beautiful garden because of sin. The way back was guarded, and from then on they would live in a world that had changed.
